'''Antonino Zichichi''' ({{IPA|it|antoˈniːno dziˈkiːki|lang-pron}}; 15 October 1929 – 9 February 2026) was an Italian physicist who worked in the field of [[nuclear physics]]. He served as President of the [[World Federation of Scientists]] and as a professor at the [[University of Bologna]].

==Life and career==
Zichichi was born in [[Trapani]], Sicily on 15 October 1929. After graduating from the Ximenes classical high school in Trapani,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.liceofardella.gov.it/GetContent.aspx?ID=264983A8-1355-4EAA-BF04-C496119FC722&sz=true&TM=V&IM=e8da75ab-84a9-4045-a61a-50193cea0e14|title=La Storia|access-date=9 February 2026|archive-date=29 July 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170729002715/http://www.liceofardella.gov.it/GetContent.aspx?ID=264983A8-1355-4EAA-BF04-C496119FC722&sz=true&TM=V&IM=e8da75ab-84a9-4045-a61a-50193cea0e14|url-status=dead}}</ref> he obtained a degree in physics from the [[University of Palermo]].<ref>{{Cite web|author=Antonella Varaschin, INFN|url=https://www.infn.it/addio-al-grande-fisico-antonino-zichichi/|title=ADDIO AL GRANDE FISICO ANTONINO ZICHICHI|website=Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare|date=9 February 2026|access-date=9 February 2026}}</ref>

He collaborated on several discoveries in the field of sub-nuclear physics and worked in numerous research laboratories such as [[Fermilab]] in Chicago and [[CERN]] in Geneva, where in 1965 he led the [[Scientific research|research]] group that first observed the [[Deuterium#Antideuterium|antideuteron]],<ref name="anti-bo">{{Cite web|title=L'antimateria all'Università di Bologna|language=it|date=5 August 2006|access-date=12 July 2011|url=http://www.df.unibo.it/divulgazione/antimateria/6-antimateria-unibo.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121223081436/http://www.df.unibo.it/divulgazione/antimateria/6-antimateria-unibo.html |archive-date=23 December 2012 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Thomas Massam (1936-2017) |url=https://www.sif.it/riviste/sif/sag/ricordo/massam |access-date=10 February 2026 |archive-date=11 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231211220605/https://www.sif.it/riviste/sif/sag/ricordo/massam |url-status=live }}<!-- auto-translated from unknown (Italian or Spanish) by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> simultaneously with an American team from the Alternating Gradient Synchrotron at Brookhaven National Laboratory.<ref>{{Cite journal|author = Dorfan, D. E|date=June 1965|title = Observation of Antideuterons|url = https://archive.org/details/sim_physical-review-letters_1965-06-14_14_24/page/1002|journal
 = Phys. Rev. Lett.|volume = 14|issue = 24|pages= 1003–1006| doi = 10.1103/PhysRevLett.14.1003|last2= Eades|first2= J.|last3= Lederman|first3= L. M.|last4= Lee|first4= W.|last5= Ting|first5= C. C.|bibcode=1965PhRvL..14.1003D|issn=0031-9007}}</ref>

In 1963, he founded the [[Ettore Majorana Foundation and Centre for Scientific Culture|''Centro Ettore Majorana'']] of [[Erice]], dedicated to scientific culture.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Zichichi|first1=Antonino|title=Ettore Majorana: genius and mystery|journal=CERN Courier|date=July 2006|volume=46|issue=6|pages=23–26|url=https://cds.cern.ch/record/1733944|archive-date=23 February 2025|access-date=16 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250223104417/https://cds.cern.ch/record/1733944|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|last1=Zichichi|first1=Antonino|title=The queen of all sciences and Intelligent Design|journal=CERN Courier|date=October 2009|volume=49|issue=8|page=42|url=https://cds.cern.ch/record/1734435}}</ref><ref name="imss" /> The Ettore Majorana centre sponsors the International School of Subnuclear Physics, where Zichichi served as director. He was president of the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]] from 1977 up to 1982, and in 1980 he strongly backed the creation of the [[Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso]].<ref name="imss" /><ref>For this action, on 2 July 2021, he was awarded an honorary degree from the [[University of Teramo]]. [https://www.unite.it/UniTE/Home/Meeting_internazionale_La_scienza_per_la_pace unite.it] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251210061926/https://www.unite.it/UniTE/Home/Meeting_internazionale_La_scienza_per_la_pace |date=10 December 2025 }}</ref> From 1978 until 1980, he served as President of the [[European Physical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.informazionecattolica.it/2020/12/17/antonino-zichichi-se-fossimo-figli-del-caos-non-potrebbero-esistere-le-leggi-fondamentali-della-natura/|date=17 December 2020|author=Angelica La Rosa|title=Antonino Zichichi: "se fossimo figli del caos, non potrebbero esistere le leggi fondamentali della natura|access-date=13 April 2024|archive-date=27 February 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240227192653/https://www.informazionecattolica.it/2020/12/17/antonino-zichichi-se-fossimo-figli-del-caos-non-potrebbero-esistere-le-leggi-fondamentali-della-natura/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://scienzapertutti.infn.it/rubriche/biografie/261-antonino-zichichi|title=Antonino Zichichi|website=Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare|access-date=13 April 2024|archive-date=27 May 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240527165835/https://scienzapertutti.infn.it/rubriche/biografie/261-antonino-zichichi|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eps.org/page/distinction_sitesFF|title=The Fermi Fountain|website=[[European Physical Society]]|access-date=13 April 2024|archive-date=8 October 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221008163736/https://www.eps.org/page/distinction_sitesFF|url-status=live}}</ref>

In 1979, during the election of the new Director-General of [[CERN]], pressure from Italy in his favour caused a clear rift between Italy and other Member States, and in the end, with 12 votes against, Zichichi's candidacy was rejected in favour of the German candidate [[Herwig Schopper]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/RaiNews/posts/%C3%A8-morto-a-96-anni-antonino-zichichi-fisico-e-divulgatore-scientifico-specializza/1384947680338415/|title=E' morto il fisico Antonino Zichichi: scienziato e divulgatore|publisher=[[Rai News 24]] - Facebook profile|access-date=9 February 2026|language=it|archive-date=9 February 2026|archive-url=https://archive.today/20260209125351/https://www.facebook.com/RaiNews/posts/%C3%A8-morto-a-96-anni-antonino-zichichi-fisico-e-divulgatore-scientifico-specializza/1384947680338415/|url-status=bot: unknown}}</ref> In 1986, he became director of World Lab,<ref name="imss">{{cite web |access-date=12 July 2011 |title=Mille anni di scienza in Italia |url=http://www.imss.fi.it/milleanni/cronologia/biografie/zichichi.html |archive-date=9 March 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130309145029/http://www.imss.fi.it/milleanni/cronologia/biografie/zichichi.html |url-status=live }}<!-- auto-translated from unknown (Italian or Spanish) by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> an association that supports scientific projects in third world countries, founded in 1973 by [[Isidor Isaac Rabi]] and Zichichi himself.<ref>{{Cite web|author=World Federation of Scientists|title=About the Organization|language=en|access-date=12 July 2011|url=http://www.federationofscientists.org/WFSHist.asp |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080807115128/http://www.federationofscientists.org/WFSHist.asp |archive-date=7 August 2008 }}</ref>

Zichichi was an emeritus professor of [[physics]] at the [[University of Bologna]].<ref>{{cite web|language=it|title=Addio al grande fisico Antonino Zichichi|url=https://www.infn.it/addio-al-grande-fisico-antonino-zichichi/|archive-url=https://archive.today/20260209125114/https://www.infn.it/addio-al-grande-fisico-antonino-zichichi/|archive-date=9 February 2025|url-status=live}}</ref> He was president of the World Federation of Scientists, an organization concerned with the fight against planetary emergencies.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.federationofscientists.org/WFSHist.asp|title=The World Federation of Scientists home page|accessdate=14 July 2008|publisher=WFS|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080807115128/http://www.federationofscientists.org/WFSHist.asp|archivedate=7 August 2008|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 1982, with [[Paul Dirac|P. A. M. Dirac]] and [[Pyotr Kapitsa]], he drafted the [[Erice statement]].<ref>{{cite journal|title=Sicily Establishes Large Award for Scientific Culture|journal=Physics Today|date=February 1990|volume=43|issue=2|page=116|doi=10.1063/1.2810454|bibcode=1990PhT....43S.116.|url=https://pubs.aip.org/physicstoday/article-abstract/43/2/116/405883/First-Free-Electron-Laser-Prize-Goes-to-Duke-s|url-access=subscription|archive-date=1 July 2023|access-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701230146/https://pubs.aip.org/physicstoday/article-abstract/43/2/116/405883/First-Free-Electron-Laser-Prize-Goes-to-Duke-s|url-status=live}}</ref> Zichichi gave the opening talk at the four-day international symposium ''Subnuclear Physics: Past, Present and Future'' held in 2011 in Vatican City.<ref>{{cite book|editor=Sánchez Sorondo, Marcelo|editor2=Zichichi, Antonino|title=Subnuclear Physics: Past, Present and Future; Proceedings of the International Symposium, held 30 October - 2 November 2011, held in Vatican City|series=Scripta Varia, volume 119|publisher=[[Pontifical Academy of Sciences]]|year=2014|isbn=978-88-7761-107-9|url=https://www.pas.va/en/publications/scripta-varia/sv119pas.html|archive-date=1 July 2023|access-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701145322/https://www.pas.va/en/publications/scripta-varia/sv119pas.html|url-status=live}}</ref> Zichichi talked with [[Pope John Paul II]] about the responsibility of the Roman Catholic Church in the case of [[Galileo Galilei]], playing a role in the public request of forgiveness issued by the Pope in October 1992.<ref>From a {{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20251221215109/https://www.facebook.com/story.php?story_fbid=1302140171929769&id=100064013951469&rdid=QfMvQ8LsCSdkL5RE|title=post}} in the official Facebook profile (15 December 2025). URL archived on 21 December 2025.</ref>

He was repeatedly critical of [[astrology]] and of the theory of [[evolutionism|evolution]], which he considered to lack sufficient scientific evidence and a mathematical model capable of describing phenomena and making future predictions of events not yet known.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ansa.it/canale_scienza/notizie/ricerca_istituzioni/2026/02/09/-e-morto-il-fisico-antonino-zichichi-_529ad66c-9589-405c-bf68-28b1a48c7027.html|title=È morto il fisico Antonino Zichichi|publisher=[[Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata|ANSA]]|language=it|archive-url=https://archive.today/20260209102947/https://www.ansa.it/canale_scienza/notizie/ricerca_istituzioni/2026/02/09/-e-morto-il-fisico-antonino-zichichi-_529ad66c-9589-405c-bf68-28b1a48c7027.html|archive-date=9 February 2026|url-status=live}}</ref> Zichichi died on 9 February 2026, at the age of 96.<ref>[https://tg24.sky.it/cronaca/2026/02/09/antonino-zichichi-morto È morto a 96 anni il fisico Antonino Zichichi] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260209103833/https://tg24.sky.it/cronaca/2026/02/09/antonino-zichichi-morto |date=9 February 2026 }} {{in lang|it}}</ref>

==Honours and assignments==
* Knight Grand Cross of the [[Order of Merit of the Italian Republic]]
* Order of Merit of the Italian Republic
* Grand Officer of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic
* President of ''[[European Physical Society]]'' (1978–1980)
* President of Italian National Institute of Nuclear Physics (1977–1982)
* President of the [[NATO]] Commission for Technologies for Disarmament
* Representative of [[EEC]] in the Scientific Committee of the International Centre for Science and Technology in Moscow
* President of the Historical Museum of Physics and the Research Centre "E. Fermi"
* Laurea Honoris Causa from [[Peking University]], [[University of Buenos Aires|Buenos Aires]], [[Malta]], [[Bucharest]], [[University of Arizona|Arizona]], [[University of Turin|Torino]]
* Member of the Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Ukraine
* Member of the Academy of Sciences of Georgia
* Member of [[Pontifical Academy of Sciences]]
*[[Pope Benedict XV]]'s member of the [[Accademia delle scienze dell'Istituto di Bologna]]<ref>{{Cite web|language=it-IT|url=https://corrieredibologna.corriere.it/notizie/cronaca/26_febbraio_09/zichichi-universita-bologna-8345c117-3002-4e54-a3dc-49780788axlk.shtml|title=L'Università di Bologna ricorda Antonino Zichichi: «Un visionario e un grande maestro, tutti sapevano chi fosse»|website=Corriere della Sera|date=9 February 2026|access-date=10 February 2026|archive-date=9 February 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260209182912/https://corrieredibologna.corriere.it/notizie/cronaca/26_febbraio_09/zichichi-universita-bologna-8345c117-3002-4e54-a3dc-49780788axlk.shtml|url-status=live}}</ref>
* Fellow, [[The World Academy of Sciences]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://twas.org/directory/zichichi-antonino|title=Zichichi, Antonino &#124; TWAS|website=twas.org|accessdate=27 September 2025|archive-date=16 September 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250916110733/https://twas.org/directory/zichichi-antonino|url-status=live}}</ref>
* [[Order of Merit of the Republic of Poland]]
* [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]]
* Enrico Fermi Award (Italian Physical Society) 
* [[Asteroid]] [[3951 Zichichi]] is named after Zichichi.

==Publications==
* ''L'infinito'', Lausanne, G. Galilei, 1988; Milano, Rizzoli, 1994 {{isbn|8817138339}}; Milano, Nuova Pratiche Editrice, 1998.
* ''Scienza ed emergenze planetarie. Il paradosso dell'era moderna'', Milano, Rizzoli, 1993. {{isbn|8817842869}}
* ''Perché io credo in Colui che ha fatto il mondo'', Milano, Il Saggiatore, 1999, {{ISBN|88-428-0714-1}}
* ''L'irresistibile fascino del Tempo. Dalla resurrezione di Cristo all'universo subnucleare'', Milano, Il Saggiatore, 2000, {{ISBN|88-515-2004-6}}
* ''Subnuclear Physics. The first 50 years highlights from Erice to ELN'', Singapore, World Scientific, 2000.
* ''Galilei divin uomo'', Milano, Il Saggiatore, 2001, {{ISBN|88-428-0943-8}}
* ''Il vero e il falso. Passeggiando tra le stelle e a casa nostra'', Milano, Il Saggiatore, 2003, {{ISBN|88-428-1078-9}}
* ''Galilei. Dall'Ipse Dixit al processo di oggi. 100 risposte'', Milano, Il Saggiatore, 2004, {{ISBN|88-428-1174-2}}
* ''Tra Fede e Scienza. Da Giovanni Paolo II a Benedetto XVI'', Milano, Il Saggiatore, 2005, {{ISBN|88-428-1310-9}}
* [https://books.google.com/books/about/Creativity_in_Science.html?id=KHyEYU00jCYC ''Creativity in Science: 6th International Zermatt Symposium Creativity in Economics, Arts and Science, Zermatt, Switzerland, 12-16 January 1996''], World Scientific, 1999; {{isbn|9810240457}}
* ''Giovanni Paolo II. Il Papa Amico della Scienza'', Marco Tropea Editore, 2011, {{ISBN|88-558-0180-5}}
* Zichichi, A.,[http://www.worldscientific.com/doi/abs/10.1142/S0217751X13300378 "Bruno Pontecorvo and his vision"]; the content of the paper is a part of the special volume published by the Italian Physical Society (2013) to celebrate the Hundredth Anniversary of [[Bruno Pontecorvo]].
